artifacts.title: NVIDIA FY2024 to FY2026 Revenue Trend
artifacts.program:
revenueData = [
  { year: "FY2026", revenue: 215.938 },
  { year: "FY2025", revenue: 130.497 },
  { year: "FY2024", revenue: 60.922 }
]

header = CardHeader("NVIDIA Revenue Trend FY2024-FY2026", "Data from NVIDIA 10-K and Annual Report")

table = Table([
  Col("Fiscal Year", ["FY2024", "FY2025", "FY2026"]),
  Col("Revenue (USD billions)", ["$60.9 billion (p.130, FY2025 report)", "$130.5 billion (p.130, FY2025 report)", "$215.9 billion (p.37, FY2026 report)"])
])

chart = LineChart(
  revenueData.year,
  [Series("Revenue (USD billions)", revenueData.revenue)],
  "linear",
  "Fiscal Year",
  "Revenue (USD billions)",
  180
)

root = Card([header, table, chart], [
  { title: "Revenue for fiscal year 2026 was $215.9 billion, up 65% from a year ago.", sourceName: "NVIDIA · Page 37", url: "https://investor.nvidia.com/files/doc_financials/2026/q4/10K-NVDA.pdf#page=37" },
  { title: "Revenue for fiscal year 2025 was $130.5 billion, up 114% from a year ago.", sourceName: "NVIDIA · Page 130", url: "https://s201.q4cdn.com/141608511/files/doc_financials/2025/annual/NVIDIA-2025-Annual-Report.pdf#page=130" },
  { title: "Revenue for fiscal year 2024 was $60.9 billion.", sourceName: "NVIDIA · Page 130", url: "https://s201.q4cdn.com/141608511/files/doc_financials/2025/annual/NVIDIA-2025-Annual-Report.pdf#page=130" }
])
